<h2>Build sjSDM Artifact Provenance</h2>

<h3>Description</h3>

<p>Constructs the common one-row provenance contract for native or migrated
cross-validation artifacts.
</p>


<h3>Usage</h3>

<pre><code class='language-R'>build_sjsdm_artifact_provenance(
  pipeline_id = NULL,
  configuration_profile = NULL,
  created_at = base::Sys.time(),
  source_schema_version = "2.0.0",
  migration_applied = FALSE,
  migration_function = NA_character_,
  stable_provenance = base::list()
)
</code></pre>


<h3>Arguments</h3>

<table role = "presentation">
<tr><td><code id="pipeline_id">pipeline_id</code></td>
<td>
<p>Pipeline identifier.</p>
</td></tr>
<tr><td><code id="configuration_profile">configuration_profile</code></td>
<td>
<p>Active configuration profile.</p>
</td></tr>
<tr><td><code id="created_at">created_at</code></td>
<td>
<p>Finite artifact creation time.</p>
</td></tr>
<tr><td><code id="source_schema_version">source_schema_version</code></td>
<td>
<p>Source artifact schema version.</p>
</td></tr>
<tr><td><code id="migration_applied">migration_applied</code></td>
<td>
<p>Whether a v1 conversion was applied.</p>
</td></tr>
<tr><td><code id="migration_function">migration_function</code></td>
<td>
<p>Converter name, or 'NA' for native v2 output.</p>
</td></tr>
<tr><td><code id="stable_provenance">stable_provenance</code></td>
<td>
<p>Optional named list of stable scientific fields.</p>
</td></tr>
</table>


<h3>Value</h3>

<p>One-row provenance tibble.
</p>

</main>
